scope: Only commissioning arm_hold_probe current-position hold, maximum 1 second; not a deployed MPPI model or approved motion path.
evaluation_rule: Recompute both original and additional shoulder/wrist support gaps at each actual q using the same original complete convex hulls and joint chain. For pair (0,18) only, a positive maximum of those support gaps proves separation; all other pairs, constraints and the existing collision threshold remain unchanged.
limitations: Recorded gap values are evidence only; never use as runtime acceptance values.
Numerical padding is not physical calibration or actuator-response validation.
A nonpositive result at any actual q remains rejected.
No additional permission for joint displacement, unfolding, MPPI or base movement.
